citations.passage:
Decision: each Wayfare display runs its own single-board computer with local
fallback rendering and no central station server — autonomy per display,

Context: after six weeks in the field, per-display autonomy shows its cost —
firmware drift across boards and roughly ninety minutes of manual reflash per
display when updates land (documented in s-004, reviewed in m-005).

judge.rationale: The answer states the same progression as the reference: per-display single-board computers in March, a shift to an edge-gateway hub per station after six weeks of firmware drift and roughly 90-minute reflashes per display, and the resulting reduction of flashing to a station-level visit by the June retro. The additional implementation details are consistent with and do not contradict the referenced account.
